audit: Public availability of RAW weak-lensing shear/ellipticity catalogues for the seven target clusters
definition_of_the_product: A per-source table carrying, at minimum, sky position and the two measured ellipticity/shear components with their errors. A convergence map, a mass map, an aperture-mass map, or an NFW-fitted mass is NOT this product and was not accepted as a substitute.
headline: A public per-source shear catalogue exists for exactly ONE of the seven targets: Abell 370.

not_available.recoverable_in_principle: Yes. LoVoCCS DECam u,g,r,i,z exposures of A2029 are public at https://astroarchive.noirlab.edu and could be re-reduced into a shear catalogue. That is a separate multi-week image-processing project, not a data-acquisition task.

explicitly_not_touched.item: KiDS Weak Gravitational Lensing Catalog (Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.16366035)
explicitly_not_touched.reason: KiDS is a PERMANENT SEALED HOLDOUT under the programme brief. It surfaced in a Zenodo keyword search and was deliberately NOT downloaded, opened or inspected. It also does not cover any target cluster.
redirects to an STScI SSO login. Access-controlled; no attempt made to circumvent.

mass_maps_deliberately_not_downloaded.reason: Programme rule: a GR-derived convergence map, an NFW-fitted mass or a parametric lens model whose mass is tied to light by construction is not an observation. Such products are available in bulk (BUFFALO lenstool_niemiec a/b1/b2/b3/c1/c2/d1/d2/e kappa, gamma, psi, deflection and magnification FITS; HFF lens models from CATS, Sharon, GLAFIC, Zitrin, Keeton, Williams, Diego, Bradac, Merten; CLASH Merten and Zitrin models) and were located but NOT downloaded.
mass_maps_deliberately_not_downloaded.if_needed_for_debugging: They are one directory listing away and must be labelled debug_only if ever pulled.
